notes.title: Zzzz-Zzzz-Zzzz receives FREEdom
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

This game is pretty old.
First released at 2013 as free game.
I wanted to update this game few times but didn't.

This year, I decide to make this game free.

There are three reasons:
[olist]
[*]Now I'm working on my brand Half-Face Games which will contain only free games.
[*]I believe every game should become free after sell time was over.
[*]I was wrong, selling my games. I make games not for money. But to give players new gaming experience. I'm sure, that "buying game" is a form of supporting developer, who made games you love to play. I don't want to force players support me anymore. If they want, they can donate, for example.
[/olist]

Everyone will be able to play Zzzz-Zzzz-Zzzz for free starting September 12th.
Maybe free game will attract new players and our community will grew.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 10 of the best new Steam games
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of ten promising but under-reported games from the torrent of new releases on Steam over the past seven days. I play a glut of titles for ten minutes each, discard any rotten ones, then choose which ten make the weekly round-up, as well as picking one stand-out favourite.

This week: myriad monochrome, haunted ice stations, smart shump remixes and the singular glory of painted lines.
